verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's own marketing pages say it offers automations, including 'Enhanced automations' on its pricing tiers, and AI analytics that report on automations. Nothing in the evidence describes multi-step journeys, welcome, onboarding or winback series, branching, delays, or exit rules. missing for 10: documented multi-step workflow builder, conditional branches, time delays, exit/goal rules, lifecycle templates (welcome/onboarding/winback), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can build multi-step lifecycle automations — welcome series, onboarding, winback — with branches, delays, and exit rules

citations.quote: Drive revenue with intuitive marketing analytics, automations, and AI tools.
explains which campaigns and automations are actually moving revenue
